All five judge.toml carry judge="claude-code" and no model/temperature/reasoning_effort lines (grep). test.sh:63-66 zeroes reward if REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL unset. Judge CLIs and browser pinned: tests/Dockerfile:16-22 npm -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1; :31 harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; :33-38 chromium installed by the playwright CLI bundled inside @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (version fixed by that package) and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which every judge.toml playwright-mcp args reference (--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --headless --isolated). Shared tools: tests/Dockerfile, test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml, .dockerignore are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff SAME); task.toml differs from template only in [task]/[metadata] identity fields. Fixed clock: the brief, rules notes, app_context and every prompt/criterion contain no calendar- or wall-clock-dependent graded rule (grep for clock/today/date/days/hours/now/timestamp found only 'within 15 seconds' latency windows and relative orderings: newest-first activity, unread 'arrived after', 30-message paging). Seed created_at values are July 2026 and only order relative data; the golden orders messages/activity by id (index.js:158,189,407-412), using the run clock only for display/created_at (index.js:59). So no graded rule depends on the run date and no fixed-clock statement is needed (row 4 checklist lists a fixed clock only where one exists). Open public verifier network (task.toml:37-38) is explicitly not a defect. Broken-app probe: an app that computed unread or ordering from wall-clock vs seed timestamps would only diverge if the grading host clock were before 2026-07-29; criteria grade observable order, so a broken app gains nothing from the clock. Conforming-alternative probe: an app sorting by created_at rather than id still orders correctly at any realistic run date (after July 2026). Minor notes (not defects, template-controlled): base images node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned not digest-pinned, and apt packages are unpinned (check-dockerfiles treats unpinned apt as NOTE); judge model nondeterminism is inherent and temperature is explicitly not required. Run status: static/source review only; raw-evidence-index scope states full configured grading is absent, so the image build/launch under these pins is not exercised by this row (owned by row 22 / runtime records).
